summary: Frontend-only test of the new inline RENAME feature in the Weekly Plan archive (PlanArchive.jsx). Logged in as admin (admin@mikilab.de), opened Il Tuo Laboratorio → capo-quicklink-settimana, added a lavorazione, saved plan 'QA Rinomina' to the archive, renamed it to 'QA Rinominato' via plan-archive-rename-btn/-input/-confirm, verified list update + persistence after full page reload, verified regression on 'Usa questo piano' (repeat) and delete. Second pass covered edge cases: rename via Enter key, empty-name confirm (no-op, keeps previous name), Escape cancel. All checks passed with zero console errors. capo-quick-archive (AI banner) intentionally not tested (LLM gated), per request.

design_issues.screen: Weekly Plan → I Miei Piani Salvati (mobile 390px)
issues: Plan name is heavily truncated ('QA Rino…') because the row packs rename + full-width 'Usa questo piano' label + delete; consider shortening the repeat label or letting the name wrap to 2 lines on narrow screens

critical_code_review_comments: PlanArchive.doRename optimistically updates local state only after a successful PATCH — correct; empty name silently cancels (matches backend 400 guard), acceptable but a small toast hint could help UX.
seed_data_creation: Temporary archived plans 'QA Rinomina'→'QA Rinominato' and 'QA Enter Test'→'QA Enter OK' created and deleted at end of each test run. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Weekly archive rename fully validated (list update, persistence across reload, Enter/Escape, empty-name guard, repeat + delete regression). Still untested: capo-quick-archive button in the AI plan banner (requires an LLM plan generation) and rename inside the 'capo' kind archive.
